title: Kevin Roose：150人决定人类未来，AI权力圈有多小？
speaker: Kevin Roose

segments.en: Well, they might be well equipped relative to the average person, but there's so few of them
segments.zh: 嗯，相对于普通人他们可能装备精良，但他们人太少了

segments.en: I mean that this is the thing like the thing that I realized reporting this book and I talked to more than 150 people
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这是我报道这本书时意识到的事，我和150多个人谈过

segments.en: At the AI labs that I covered open AI andthropic and Google deep mind
segments.zh: 在我报道的AI实验室，OpenAI、Anthropic和Google DeepMind

segments.en: And that was essentially how big the group of key decision-makers was it started off as like a couple dozen people who are interested in this about a decade ago
segments.zh: 这基本上就是关键决策者群体的规模，大约十年前开始时只有几十个对此感兴趣的人

segments.en: And they grasped something about the world that wasn't obvious
segments.zh: 他们抓住了世界上一些并不明显的东西

segments.en: Which is that powerful AI was possible and that some recent advances and things like GPUs had made it
segments.zh: 那就是强大的AI是可能的，而GPU等近期进展让它

segments.en: It made it seem realistic and then the circle kind of stayed small for a long time
segments.zh: 让它看起来现实，然后这个圈子在很长时间里保持很小

segments.en: We're like maybe a hundred people maybe a hundred and fifty people actually were involved in creating the technologies that we see today
segments.zh: 大概一百人，也许一百五十人真正参与了创造我们今天看到的技术

segments.en: And no matter how good or moral or well equipped those people are
segments.zh: 无论这些人多么优秀、有道德或装备精良

segments.en: Like it's a very small group of people to be building this thing and making all the decisions that could affect
segments.zh: 这么小一群人构建这个东西并做出所有可能影响

segments.en: Billions of people are on the world. And by the way, it's a very homogeneous group. Yes. No, these are like mostly men in San Francisco
segments.zh: 世界上数十亿人的决定。顺便说一句，这是一个非常同质的群体。是的。不，这些人大多是旧金山的男性

segments.en: They are blinkered. They don't sort of have the rest of humanity's experience to draw from
segments.zh: 他们视野狭窄，没有其余人类的经验可以借鉴

segments.en: And they're all racing each other. That is the craziest thing
segments.zh: 而且他们都在互相竞赛。这是最疯狂的事

segments.en: It's like they understand the stakes of what they're doing. They're not naive
segments.zh: 他们明白自己所做事情的风险。他们并不天真

segments.en: If they think this thing could blow up the world
segments.zh: 如果他们觉得这东西可能炸毁世界

segments.en: But they're all racing toward it anyway
segments.zh: 但他们还是都朝它冲过去
